name: Bouncie
description: The Bouncie connector gives Claude access to connected vehicle data — including live GPS location, trip history, driving behavior metrics, device status, and vehicle details. Query trip summaries, analyze driving patterns, look up mileage, and monitor fleet health across any Bouncie-registered device.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Bouncie to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Bouncie to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://integrations.bouncie.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Bouncie MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bouncie provides these MCP tools: calculateTripStats, getLatestTrip, getTrip, getUserVehicles, getVehicleOverview, tripTimeline, and vehicleCareEvents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Bouncie?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Bouncie in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Bouncie requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Bouncie is developed by Bouncie. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
